evidenceRules: A syntactic positive is not exact native extraction. Prior publisher originals are historical until independently requalified.

entries.rule: RFC6587 3.4 octet counting versus nontransparent framing and record limits
entries.observation: Stream splitting, UTF-8 length accounting, LF/CRLF/NUL/leading-zero checks exist. Need lossless octet and truncation transfer tests against native receiver.
entries.next: STD-1 stream/forwarder exact boundary and native contract verification

entries.rule: PRI, timestamp, relay and free-form message
entries.observation: Multiple qualified original extractors exist. Strict TAG and generic envelope paths intentionally differ. Year/timezone unknown must not be fabricated.
entries.next: STD-2 compare exact envelopes and relay attribution in one frozen scope

entries.rule: RFC5424 6.3 structured data escaping and NILVALUE
entries.observation: Byte scanner preserves unknown SD escapes in its raw source form while general envelope scanner abstains; RFC5424 SD must not be confused with MSG CEF escape.
entries.next: STD-2 add same-input/independent-standard expected-value transfer probes

entries.rule: CEF header escaped pipe/backslash and extension escaped equals/backslash/newline, spaces inside values
entries.observation: Browser core correctly matched six standards-derived CEF escaping/spacing examples. This does not establish source spans, complete-event precision or native parity.

entries.rule: CEF escaped header/extension values and UTF-8 source offsets
entries.observation: One source-span observer abstains on standard escaped pipes/backslashes/spaced values that browser core can decode. Do not advertise this as entire product CEF escape failure.
entries.next: STD-3 design a shared standard lexer returning separate raw and decoded source intervals

entries.rule: All mandatory CEF header fields present/defined and severity constrained to documented enumeration
entries.observation: Browser extraction returned no errors for empty deviceVendor, blank severity and numeric severity 99. Isolated bounded header audit now abstains on these without vendor-specific rules.
entries.next: STD-3 add independent format-level header validation before any success decision

entries.rule: LEEF 2.0 literal, 0xHH, xHH and Unicode delimiter handling
entries.observation: Browser core passed x5E, 0x5E and xa6 synthetic examples; independent source observer abstained on some, preserving raw instead of inventing spans.
entries.next: STD-4 cross-check source offsets, duplicate keys and format-level positive/negative paths

entries.rule: RFC8259 section 4 recommends unique object member names; duplicate resolution is non-interoperable
entries.observation: Browser JSON.parse silently keeps the last of two same-named fields while returning errors=[]. New isolated bounded source gate preserves REVIEW_ONLY and detects nested/Unicode-escaped duplicate keys.
entries.next: STD-5 shared source-loss preflight for JSON objects and native parity

entries.rule: RFC8259 number interoperability and IEEE754 exponent/precision limits
entries.observation: A JSON exponent outside finite double range yields JS Infinity with no parser error. The isolated gate reports numeric representation risk.
entries.next: STD-5 bounded preflight and typed provenance before normalization

entries.observation: Escaped unpaired surrogate produces non-interoperable JS Unicode without browser error; isolated gate marks uncertain rather than complete.
entries.next: STD-5 byte-level original/decoded code point policy

entries.rule: RFC7464 record separator, LF and recoverability
entries.observation: Bounded parser accepts only JSON object records and requires LF; RFC7464 allows other JSON values. This is a product policy subset, not proof of universal RFC7464 coverage.
entries.next: STD-5 verify recovery/truncation and limitations explicitly

entries.rule: RFC4180 escaped quotes, quoted comma, CRLF, positional empty/trailing columns
entries.observation: Quoted comma, doubled-quote, empty positional fields and invalid quotation behaved conservatively on four synthetic cases.
entries.next: STD-6 native parser source offsets and multiline row membership

entries.rule: RFC4180 spaces are part of a field and should not be ignored by default
entries.observation: Browser tokenizeCSV trims ordinary unquoted cell spaces while strict RFC4180 table parser preserves them. Any producer policy that trims must be explicit, not claimed RFC default.
entries.next: STD-6 preserve lexical cell values and verify selected normalization policy separately

entries.rule: Producer-declared KV completeness, not universal RFC grammar
entries.observation: Browser regex matches good assignments but ignores unmatched trailing garbage with errors=[]. Isolated source gate returns uncertain and no promoted fields.
entries.next: STD-7 verify consumed byte coverage before field completeness

entries.rule: No producer-independent semantics of arbitrary backslash escape
entries.observation: Browser regex accepts an escaped string without producer contract. Isolated source gate abstains from asserting decoded values.
entries.next: STD-7 bind original bytes, producer profile and explicit typed expectations

entries.rule: Directive-defined field names, separators, types and absent/empty value tokens
entries.observation: Delimited W3C/Zeek structures exist but official Zeek code default options now pinned to immutable upstream revision; do not claim full directive conformance.
entries.next: STD-7 test version-pinned Zeek writer state rotation/close and W3C declared source

entries.rule: Candidate precedence, overlap and residual parse confidence
entries.observation: Generic Structural / bounded Funnel exist, but 23-case source/preview differences are not product-native extraction truth. Need explicit negative-route and false-complete scoring.
entries.next: STD-8 pin same-source competing candidates, explain arbitration

entries.rule: Separate normative synthetic tests, upstream publisher source oracles and proprietary firmware/wire evidence
entries.observation: 11 authoritative references pinned, including immutable upstream Zeek logging definitions. 23 synthetic standard-derived probes are NOT independent field-value/location or native runtime goldens.
entries.next: STD-9 add sealed external multi-producer expected source values and complete-event goldens where available

entries.rule: Native Fluentd/Stellar generated parser and source-stage parity
entries.observation: Backend/native plugin has separate execution tests but no equivalent exact-head standard conformance accepted in this isolated source audit.
entries.next: STD-11 native baseline comparison without modifying backend or live target
